simplematica.config.generic.comment.debu:
Change the behavior of the Debug Information that is displayed
under the F3 screen for the Litematica World Renderer.
[§eDefault§r]: Fixed injection above `F3 + F6` help text. (Classic behavior)
[§bVanilla Configurable§r]: Allow the Litematica F3 Debug Hud to be `F3 + F6` configurable.
[§cOFF§r]: Turn OFF the Litematica F3 Debug Hud.

§6NOTE: Making this Vanilla configurable may shift other Debug lines around.
§6This is how the `F3 + F6` works based on the height of the text that is shown on screen.
§6The results will vary and can be unpredictable based on how many that are enabled.

Enable the Schematic Placement Manager's
Thread Daemon debug line under your F3 screen.

§bT§r - This shows you the Thread count (Max 4)
§bRB§r - This shows you the pending 'Rebuild' task count
§bUL§r - This shows you the pending 'Unload' task count
§bO§r - This shows you the pending 'Other' task count
§bD§r - This shows you the 'Deferred' task count§r

These threads are responsible for all of the
Schematic Worlds' Chunk loading & maintenance tasks.

Enable the Schematic World debug line under
your F3 screen. (§dExtended debug while running in an IDE§r)

§bE§r - Regular entity count
§bTE§r - Tile Entity count
§bC§r - Loaded Chunks count
§bCT§r - Touched-Chunks total count
§bCV§r - Last Visible-Chunks count
[bE§r - entityMap count [§dExtended Debug§r]
§bU§r - uuidMap count [§dExtended Debug§r]
§bC§r - chunkMap count [§dExtended Debug§r]

simplematica.config.generic.comment.dedu:
De-Duplicate any matching entities loaded into the Schematic World.

The current code tries to spawn the entities with their exact
UUID and EntityID if they were saved; so we needed a new
mechanism to manage duplicate UUID's and Entity ID's.
This config when disabled, adds any secondary copies of
the same Entity with a new random UUID.

Enabling this will be useful if you want to ensure that
your Schematic Entities fully match their original values;
such as when pasting the same minecart multiple times over,
and doing so might break your redstone.

simplematica.config.generic.comment.plac:
Adjust the Placement Manager Thread performance metrics as follows:

MAX - 32 tasks per cycle (20ms yield, 2048 deferred cap)
DEFAULT - 16 tasks per cycle (50ms yield, 1024 deferred cap)
MINIMAL - 8 tasks per cycle (100ms yield, 512 deferred cap)
POTATO - 4 task per cycle (150ms yield, 128 deferred cap)

Lower profiles reduce CPU load and prevent frame drops on weaker
systems, but chunk rebuilds will take noticeably longer to complete.

Set the max number of Placement Manager Threads
NOTE: The default value (§e0§r) safely scales to your
system's CPU core count, and the actual thread usage
can be seen by enabling the §bdebugHudPMThreads§r
config for your F3 screen.
§6NOTE: Just because you can technically allocate
§616 threads, doesn't mean you should.
§eGenerally, 2 or 4 should be enough for most users.

simplematica.message.warn.schematic_load:
警告: 非Litematica形式の図面を直接読み込んだ場合，
作成された配置は永続的には保存されません．
また，大規模な図面の場合，図面タイプの変換によるラグが発生します．

そのため，図面をインポートし，図面管理メニューから
Litematica形式で保存することを推奨します．
または，MCEditやLitematicaの貼り付けモードを使用して
元の図面を一時的なワールドに貼り付け，
そこから新しいLitematica図面を作成することを推奨します．
この際，可能であれば複数の子領域を使用して
建築物を正確に捉えるのが理想的です．
simplematica.message.warn.schematic_rebu:
対象となる配置が選択されていません．
「すべて置換」ショートカットは，クリックした配置内の選択中の子領域にのみ機能します．そのため，特定の子領域内のブロックを置換する場合には，その子領域を選択する必要があります．図面全体(すべての子領域)で置換を実施する場合には，子領域ではなく配置全体を選択する必要があります．
また，置換は現在のレイヤ描画設定で制限された領域内に対してのみ行われます．
